test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 19 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains the grammatical error.**

Smita lived in this house since she was five years old.
solution:
The erroneous segment is "**Smita lived**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The rule is: **Present Indefinite + Time expression= Present Perfect**.
 
• Some of the important Time expressions are:
 
 
• For (period of time)
 
• Since (point of time)
 
 
 
• For example:
 
 
• Monika has known me for two months. (“two months” is a period of time)
 
• Monika **has known** me **since** 1995. (“1995” is a point of time)
 
 
 
• In this question,** 'since' **is the **point of time **that is used here. Hence, the **present perfect tense** is appropriate here.
 
• Thus, 'has lived' must replace 'lived' (past tense).

Therefore, the correct answer is: Smita **has lived **in this house since she was five years old.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**
